answer: Reaching eligibility takes 49 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone burns for every seat it wants. The umber register is checked at draw time, lantern lists the eligible set, and violet seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 49 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. A 226 account operation therefore ties up 4 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
